BOOK ONE · LESSON 109

A good idea

好主意

Charlotte makes coffee for Jane. They discuss how much milk, sugar, and other things Jane wants. The lesson covers the difference between 'a little/a few' and 'little/few', as well as comparative and superlative forms.

109 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

  1. 1

    Charlotte

    Shall I make some coffee, Jane?

    我来煮点咖啡好吗，简？

  2. 2

    Jane

    That's a good idea, Charlotte.

    这是个好主意，夏洛特。

  3. 3

    Charlotte

    It's ready. Do you want any milk?

    咖啡好了，你要放点奶吗？

  4. 4

    Jane

    Just a little, please.

    请稍加一点。

  5. 5

    Charlotte

    What about some sugar? Two teaspoonfuls?

    加些糖怎么样？两茶匙行吗？

  6. 6

    Jane

    No, less than that. One and a half teaspoonfuls, please. That's enough for me.

    不，再少一些。请放一勺半。那对我已足够了。

  7. 7

    Jane

    That was very nice.

    太好了。

  8. 8

    Charlotte

    Would you like some more?

    你再来点儿吗？

  9. 9

    Jane

    Yes, please.

    好的，请再来一点。

  10. 10

    Jane

    I'd like a cigarette, too. May I have one?

    我还想抽支烟。可以给我一支吗？

  11. 11

    Charlotte

    Of course. I think there are a few in that box.

    当然可以。我想那个盒子里有一些。

  12. 12

    Jane

    I'm afraid it's empty.

    恐怕盒子是空的。

  13. 13

    Charlotte

    What a pity!

    真遗憾！

  14. 14

    Jane

    It doesn't matter.

    没关系。

  15. 15

    Charlotte

    Have a biscuit instead. Eat more and smoke less!

    那就吃块饼干吧。多吃点儿，少抽点儿！

  16. 16

    Jane

    That's very good advice!

    这是极好的忠告啊！

New words & expressions 生词和短语

idea /aɪ'dɪə/
n. 主意
a little /ə 'lɪtl/
adj. 少许（用于不可数名词之前）
teaspoonful /'tiːspuːnfl/
n. 一满茶匙
less /les/
adj. （little的比较级）较少的，更小的
a few /ə 'fjuː/
adj. 几个（用于可数名词之前）
pity /'pɪti/
n. 遗憾
instead /ɪn'stɛd/
adv. 代替
advice /əd'vaɪs/
n. 建议，忠告

Notes on the text 课文注释

less than that

less than that，意思是'比那稍微少一些'，其中的that指上文中的two teaspoonfuls。

I'd

I'd = I would; I'd like ...，我想要……。

What a pity!

What a pity! 真遗憾。英语中常用'What a + 可数名词'和'What + 不可数名词'的结构来表示感叹。

03

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATION

Grammar 语法练习

Grammar I: Write the comparative and superlative forms

Write the comparative and superlative forms of the adjectives.

写出下列形容词的比较级和最高级形式。

Write the comparative and superlative forms of each adjective.

Grammar II: Complete the dialogues according to the examples

Complete the dialogues according to the examples. Example: Would you like some butter? → Yes, please. I'd like some butter. I've got very little. / Would you like some milk? → No, thank you. I don't want any milk. I still have a little.

仿照例句完成下列对话。例句：你想来点黄油吗？→ 是的，请。我想要些黄油。我剩得很少了。/ 你想来点牛奶吗？→ 不，谢谢。我不想要任何牛奶。我还有一点。

Complete each dialogue using 'a little/little' or 'a few/few' appropriately. Items 1a and 2a are printed examples.

Grammar III: Fill in the blanks with 'little', 'a little', 'few' or 'a few'

Fill in the blanks with 'little', 'a little', 'few' or 'a few'.

用little, a little, few或a few填空。

Fill in each blank with the correct form: 'little', 'a little', 'few', or 'a few'.

Grammar IV: Make dialogues according to the example

Make dialogues according to the example. Example: I/got a good mark in the exam/John/Jane → I got a good mark in the exam. / You're right. But John got a better mark. And Jane got the best mark of all.

仿照例句编写对话。例句：I/got a good mark in the exam/John/Jane → 我在考试中得了个好分数。/ 你说得对。但John得了更好的分数。而Jane得了所有人中最好的分数。

Make a dialogue for each set of words using positive, comparative, and superlative forms. Item 1 is a printed example.
